main_idea: Distillation lifts Nemotron Nano and Qwen3.5-9B on GDPval against their base models.
ideas: Nemotron Nano gains +20.9% net win-loss margin
Student beats base on most of 220 tasks
summary: Clutter comes from the eyebrow tag, explanatory subtitle, card and row frames, footer lines, and a repeated Qwen label row; the graphic lacks an explicit base-model comparison for its stat rows.

missing.why: Stat rows never say the win-loss and rubric gains are versus the base model.
The model being compared against is never named.
